# @classytic/arc

> Resource-oriented backend framework for Fastify. One defineResource() = REST + validation + auth + permissions + events + cache + OpenAPI + MCP. DB-agnostic through @classytic/repo-core adapter kits (mongokit, sqlitekit, prismakit).

Hand-rolling is a bug in arc apps. Check this table before writing any route, validation, auth check, job, counter or audit code.

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| CRUD + OpenAPI + MCP | defineResource({ name, adapter, permissions }) |
| Role / ownership / row policy | @classytic/arc/permissions: requireRoles, requireOwnership, allowPublic({ policy }), anyOf |
| Tenant / user id in a handler | @classytic/arc/scope: requireOrgId, getUserId |
| Body schema on a route | routeInput({ body }) from @classytic/arc/core (zod v4, parsed once) |
| Body schema on CRUD writes | crudInput({ create, update }) |
| Action body schema | actions.x.schema = the schema itself (never { body }); defineAction({ schema, parse: true }) |
| Empty action body | noPayloadSchema |
| Filter / sort / page | resource queryParser (allow-listed), keyset cursors |
| Soft delete, slug, tree, bulk, files, search | presets: [...] |
| Recurring job | schedulesPlugin / module scheduledJobs (lock or singleReplica) |
| Once per local day at hh:mm in a zone | scheduledJobs daily: { hour, minute, zone, ledger } |
| Durable queue | @classytic/arc/integrations/jobs (BullMQ) |
| Headless worker | createWorker(sameOptions) from @classytic/arc/factory |
| Usage counters, quotas, plan limits | @classytic/arc/usage: usagePlugin, requireQuota; rateLimit.plan |
| Audit, record history | audit: true, history: true |
| Idempotency | @classytic/arc/idempotency |
| Events, outbox, webhooks | @classytic/arc/events, createOutboxModule, integrations/webhooks |
| AI / MCP tools | generated per resource; mcpPlugin from @classytic/arc/mcp |
| Unknown route 404 | built in: ErrorContract arc.not_found (errorHandler.notFound to replace) |
| Tests | createTestApp, expectArc from @classytic/arc/testing |
| App boot | createApp({ beforeBoot: connectDb, resources, auth }) from @classytic/arc/factory |

## Read next

- skills/arc/SKILL.md: golden paths, gotchas, reference index
- skills/arc/references/: one topic per file (validation, schedules, resources, permissions, auth, events, mcp, production, testing)
- skills/arc-code-review/SKILL.md: audit a codebase for hand-rolled code
- skills/arc-module-publishing/SKILL.md: ship a reusable arc module

## Conventions that bite

- request.user is undefined on public routes: guard it.
- Custom endpoints go in routes: / actions: (they inherit auth, OpenAPI, MCP); a bare fastify.get() bypasses all of it.
- { body: X } as an action schema validates nothing; strictSchemas: true makes it fatal.
- Zod v4 in every schema slot; .default() stays optional on the wire.
- Errors are the repo-core ErrorContract: { code, message, status }.
- schemaGenerator: false on a kit adapter removes OpenAPI and MCP bodies.
- Own hook that refuses: return reply.send(...) or throw (see writes-hooks-errors.md).
